fields.description: Jumeirah Residences Emirates Towers is a Meraas residential development near DIFC and the Museum of the Future. Its two towers offer one- to four-bedroom homes, with Jumeirah services and shared garden-level facilities complemented by elevated leisure spaces.

research.community: Jumeirah Residences Emirates Towers · Trade Centre
overview: The briefing counts 754 homes: 394 in Tower A and360 in Tower B. Its mix includes ordinary and double-height three-bedroom homes plus special four-bedroom residences. The executive gym is designated for three- and four-bedroom homes.

Security, concierge and common-area services are listed separately from paid options such as housekeeping, personal training, private chefs and childcare. Confirm ongoing charges and which facilities serve the chosen residence.
research.locationNote: Along the Sheikh Zayed Road/Trade Centre setting beside DIFC, the Museum of the Future and Jumeirah Emirates Towers. Promotional driving times are traffic-dependent; neighbouring hotel facilities are not automatically ownership entitlements.
research.priceLabel: Tower B published starting guide · reconfirm
research.priceNote: The linked Tower B sheet lists AED 3.94 m one bedroom; 5.25 m two; 7.14 m two plus maid; 10.94 m three; 13.2 m three double-height; 36.7 m four. These dated release guides do not establish current stock or Tower A pricing.
research.paymentNote: Tower B’s sheet: 20% booking; 5% November 2025; 5% April 2026; 10% September 2026; 10% February 2027; 5% June 2027; 5% October 2027; 40% August 2030 handover. Past launch milestones cannot be treated as a new buyer’s future calendar.
research.handoverNote: Tower B’s developer sheet estimates August 2030; Property Finder lists September 2030. Confirm the contracted tower and date.
